diagnostics.message: module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.this only references the pod-execution IAM role (aws_iam_role.this[0].arn) and never the policy attachment. Unlike the node-group modules (which enforce this ordering through a launch template that carries depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this]), the Fargate module has no such path, so the profile can be created before the pod-execution role has AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy attached. IAM is eventually consistent, so Fargate pods scheduled right after will fail with authorization errors until the policy propagates. The profile should depend_on module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this (a bare depends_on is required — no attribute on the profile can reference the attachment to infer it implicitly).
